requirements.title: Who may modify a change
requirements.rationale: An org member must be able to edit the change they opened into a workspace they can only read, and nobody else who can merely read it may touch it.

criteria.condition: PATCH /workspaces/:slug/changes/:number, POST …/abandon or POST …/restore is called by the user whose id is the change's author.actor_id with any credential of that user, by a caller with write access to the target workspace, or with the admin token
criteria.action: pass the request on to the validation and state checks of the route
criteria.contract: the route answers with its own result (HTTP 200 for a valid request), never 403 forbidden

criteria.condition: one of the three routes is called by a caller who can read the target workspace and is neither the change's author, nor a caller with write access to the target workspace, nor the admin token
criteria.action: refuse the request and leave the change unchanged
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 with error_type forbidden; a following GET of the change returns the same body as before the call

requirements.rationale: The intent travels with the change, so its author must be able to state and correct it after opening.

criteria.action: store the named members together, keep every member that is absent from the body, replace the whole labels list with the given one after removing duplicates (first occurrence kept), advance updated_at and write no event
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with the change object carrying the new values; a following GET returns the same object

requirements.title: Move a change between draft and open
requirements.rationale: A draft is work nobody should land or review yet; marking it ready is the moment reviewers and automation are told.

criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with state open and landing.reason not 'draft'; one event parley.change.open with actor the caller, resource_type change, resource_id the number, and metadata number, ref, version, head_sha, title, target_branch, source_workspace, source_branch, depends_on and was_draft true

requirements.title: Retarget a change
requirements.rationale: A change opened against the wrong branch, or one whose target was deleted, must be movable without losing its number, versions and approvals history.

criteria.condition: a PATCH names a target_branch that differs from the current one, on a draft or open change that has no depends_on and no dependants, and the branch passes the target rules of opening
criteria.action: set target_branch, set base_sha to the merge base of head_sha with the new target's head, recompute stats and paths against it, create no version, re-evaluate landing, set mergeable to unknown, schedule the mergeability check, forget the ready announcement, and write one parley.change.version event with kind retarget in the same transaction
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with the new target_branch, base_sha, stats and paths, the same version number and head_sha, and mergeable 'unknown'; GET …/versions lists the same versions as before; one event parley.change.version with actor the caller and metadata number, ref, version, head_sha, kind 'retarget', base_sha, patch_equivalent_to null and draft

requirements.title: Abandon a change
requirements.rationale: Work that will not land must leave the list of open work without losing what was pushed.

criteria.condition: POST /workspaces/:slug/changes/:number/abandon is called on a draft or open change that has no dependants, with no body, an empty object, or a body with a string reason
criteria.action: move the change to abandoned, drop its pending mergeability check, leave its source branch and every version ref in place, and write one parley.change.abandon event in the same transaction
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with state abandoned; the source branch still resolves to the same commit and refs/parley/changes/<number>/<version> still resolves for every version; one event parley.change.abandon with actor the caller and metadata number, ref, version, head_sha and reason (the given string, or the empty string when absent)
